name: contract-output-formatter
description: Format contract work products into the delivery shape that best matches the hit scenario (C1-C9) and the reading audience. Use this skill as the LAST step before replying, after drafting/review/research/advisory work is done. It selects the right artifact form (contract text, review opinion, risk list, supplemental agreement, management policy, negotiation playbook, formal letter, etc.), unifies citation style and structure, marks risk levels, and appends the standard disclaimer. CRITICAL for review of a user-supplied .docx contract (C6/C9): the default deliverable is a redlined .docx with native Word track changes (character-level insert/delete) plus comment bubbles, produced by bin/redline-docx — NOT a "before/after" excerpt block. This skill does not generate new legal substance — it only shapes, orders, and finalizes what upstream skills produced.

findings.excerpt: python3 <expert>/bin/redline-docx apply --in 原合同.docx --edits edits.json --out 修订稿.docx --author "合同专家"
